questions.question: What must PCA do before forming the covariance matrix?
options: Replace all features with their absolute values
Center each feature by subtracting its sample mean
questions.explanation: Centering makes the covariance describe variation around the data mean rather than the location of the cloud.

questions.question: For centered points [1,1], [2,2], [3,3], which PCA direction captures the variance?
questions.explanation: All points lie on the diagonal x=y. The first principal component follows that line; the perpendicular direction has zero variance.

questions.question: Eigenvalues of a covariance matrix are 9 and 1. What explained-variance ratio does PC1 have?
questions.explanation: Explained variance uses eigenvalue divided by the total: 9/(9+1)=0.9.

questions.question: Which interpretation of a 2D t-SNE plot is safest?
options: Every global distance is preserved exactly
Local neighborhoods are emphasized, but distances between separate clusters are not reliable
The layout is deterministic regardless of seed
It can only represent linear projections
questions.explanation: t-SNE is stochastic and optimizes local neighborhood structure. Apparent spacing between clusters should not be read as a global metric.

questions.question: What generally happens in UMAP when n_neighbors is increased?
options: Every point becomes an isolated cluster
The input dimension increases by n_neighbors
The embedding considers broader neighborhoods and tends to preserve more global structure
The algorithm becomes exactly the same as PCA
questions.explanation: Larger neighborhoods connect more of the data graph, trading some local detail for a stronger view of global relationships.

questions.question: Why can RBF kernel PCA separate concentric circles when ordinary PCA cannot?
options: PCA always discards the labels, while kernel PCA reads them from the target column
The RBF kernel guarantees that every point maps to a different class
Kernel PCA skips centering and therefore preserves all original coordinates
The kernel represents nonlinear similarity in a feature space where the circles can become linearly separable
questions.explanation: A linear projection cannot turn concentric rings into separated lines in the original plane. The RBF similarity provides a nonlinear feature geometry before the principal directions are taken.
